name: rnd-coder
description: Coding loop for the R&D desk: connect a repository, pick up a task, write back through PR and merge, log the changelog. / 研发执行手册：接入仓库、领任务、开发到合并全程回写、写变更记录。

label.en: Pick up a task and deliver it
label.zh-CN: 领一个任务并做到合并

body.en:
{target}

Follow this skill's coding loop for the task I name (or the top To do task of this repository's product): claim it, implement and verify it against its acceptance criteria, open the pull request, and on merge mark it done and write the changelog row.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的研发流程处理我指定的任务（没指定就领本仓库所属产品里排第一的「待开始」任务）：认领、实现、对照验收标准验证、开 PR，合并后标为已完成并写变更记录。

label.en: Connect this code repository to the desk
label.zh-CN: 把这个代码仓库接到研发管理台

body.en:
{target}

Follow this skill's 'Connect a repository' steps for the repository I am in: find or register its product, then draft the pointer block for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md with the real ids. Show me before committing.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册「接入代码仓库」的步骤处理当前仓库：找到或登记它所属的产品，然后用真实 id 起草写进 AGENTS.md 或 CLAUDE.md 的指针段落。提交前先给我看。

label.en: Check this week's changelog for gaps
label.zh-CN: 检查本周变更记录有没有漏

body.en:
{target}

Compare this week's merged pull requests with the changelog using this skill's backfill steps, and list what is missing or written in engineer-speak. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

按这份手册的补记步骤，对比本周已合并的 PR 和变更记录，列出漏记的、以及写成工程师黑话的条目。不要修改任何记录。

label.en: Add a new rule to the coding playbook
label.zh-CN: 把新定的规矩写进研发手册

body.en:
{target}

Fold the rule I describe into this skill's SKILL.md where it belongs, keeping the rest unchanged, and show me the diff before proposing the change.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

把我说的新规矩写进这份 SKILL.md 合适的位置，其余内容保持不变，提交变更前先给我看改动。

label.en: Explain the coding loop to a new engineer
label.zh-CN: 给新同事讲清研发流程

body.en:
{target}

Explain this skill to a new engineer in five minutes: the two promises, what to update at each step, and what an agent must never do. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN:
{target}

用五分钟给新同事讲清这份手册：两条承诺、每一步要回写什么、Agent 绝不能做什么。不要修改任何记录。
